livenessProbe.description:
Check the listen socket in /proc/net/tcp (8088 = 0x1F98): tcpSocket
probes crash the handler on disconnect.
livenessProbe.title: livenessProbe

mode.description:
One of: tcp, ssl, udp. Maps to the eud_handler --ssl/--udp flags for the
primary container.
NOTE: the default livenessProbe/readinessProbe check the TCP 8088
socket; when mode is `ssl` or `udp`, override them to match the
listener (8089 = 0x1F99; 8087 is UDP, see /proc/net/udp).
mode.title: mode

Additional `eud_handler --ssl` container (mTLS streaming); waits for the
CA material published by the web pod.

readinessProbe.description:
Check the listen socket in /proc/net/tcp (8089 = 0x1F99): tcpSocket
probes crash the handler on disconnect without a TLS handshake.
readinessProbe.title: readinessProbe

The upstream bitnami chart defaults to the floating `latest` tag.
Pin the frozen bitnamilegacy build instead so the DB engine version
is fixed. (Bitnami publishes only `latest` on docker.io/bitnami.)

external.description:
OTS only supports the default vhost (/) and AMQP port (5672), so only
host and credentials are configurable here.

password.title: password

external.title: external

extraVolumes.description:
The chart creates the definitions Secret under whatever secretName is
referenced here, so any release name works.
extraVolumes.title: extraVolumes

plugins.description:
MQTT on 1883 with device auth delegated to the OTS API. The auth_http
URLs must point at "<release fullname>-web" on OTS_LISTENER_PORT; the
shipped defaults assume the release is literally named "opentakserver".
For any other release name, rewrite the host in these URLs (subchart
values cannot be templated).
plugins.title: plugins

create.description: Create the Role/RoleBinding used by the ca-publisher sidecar.
create.title: create

automount.description:
Pod specs override this: only the web pod mounts the token (for the
ca-publisher sidecar); all other components set it false.
automount.title: automount

ui.description:
UI component: nginx serving the SPA and proxying /api, /Marti and
/socket.io to the web service (separate image, no OTS security defaults).

enrollment.description:
TLS endpoint on 8446 for automatic certificate enrollment; nginx
terminates TLS with the published OTS CA cert. Served by a dedicated
Service so it can be exposed (e.g. LoadBalancer) independently of the
HTTP UI service, which stays ClusterIP + Ingress.
enrollment.title: enrollment

tag.description: Upstream only publishes the rolling `master` tag; pin the digest.
tag.title: tag
